headline: Execution recovery and deleveraging remain key

highlights: Management expects a sharp H2FY27 recovery, retaining its FY27 revenue guidance of INR 60bn, implying H2 execution of INR 42bn (up 50% YoY) and EBITDA margins of 13–14%.
For FY28, revenue is targeted at INR 70bn (+15% YoY), supported by improved execution across segments.
The order book stood at INR 137bn (3x book-to-bill), with FY27 order inflow guidance of INR 100–110bn, of which INR 55bn was secured in H1FY27.
We estimate EPS growth of 29%/39% in FY28E/FY29E, driven by execution recovery, revenue ramp-up and margin improvement.
valuation: Infra Engineering (HGINFRA IN) Q2FY27 Result Update November 04, 2026 ☑ Estimate Change | ☑ Target | ◼ Reco.
For FY28, revenue is targeted at INR 70bn (+15% YoY), supported by improved execution across segments.
We retain our Accumulate rating but revise our target price to INR 449 (from INR 662), factoring in a lower EPC valuation multiple of 5x.
watch: Key catalysts include an execution ramp-up across the existing order book, monetisation-led debt reduction and improved working capital, driving stronger earnings growth and lower finance costs.

Guidance and outlook: Despite a weak H1FY27, management reiterated its FY27 revenue guidance of INR 60 bn, with execution expected to recover sharply in H2FY27 to approximately INR 42 bn, implying 15% YoY growth over H2FY26.
